```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(metafor) # calculate effect size and do meta analysis
library(lmtest)
library(readr) # read in data
library(dplyr)# handle data

# load ER partitioning data
data <- read_csv("df_3.csv")
data$treatment<-as.factor(data$treatment)

# subset GS data
data <- subset(data, season_automatic == "GS" & c_loss=="CO2", )
data <- subset(data, site_id_automatic != "CAN_2" & site_id_automatic != "CAN_3" & site_id_automatic != "CAN_4" & site_id_automatic != "SWE_12", )

# count number of missing values in each column
missing_cols <- colSums(is.na(data))
# subset dataset to remove columns with only missing values
ER_data <- subset(data, select = -which(missing_cols == nrow(data)))
```


```{r prepare data for effect sizes - heterotrophic respiration}

# merge site_id_automatic and flux_year_automatic
ER_data$ID <- paste(ER_data$site_id_automatic,ER_data$flux_year_automatic, sep="_")
ER_data$ID <- as.factor(ER_data$ID)

# observations within an ID (site_id + year)
obs_id<-ER_data %>% 
  group_by(site_id_automatic, treatment) %>%
  dplyr::count(ID) 

#extract heterotrophic respiration
ER_hr <- ER_data %>% 
  group_by(ID, treatment) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(mean=mean(co2_heterotrophic_respiration, na.rm = TRUE), 
            sd=sd(co2_heterotrophic_respiration, na.rm = TRUE), 
            n=n()
            )

ER_CTL <- ER_hr  %>% dplyr::filter(treatment=="CTL")
ER_OTC <- ER_hr  %>% dplyr::filter(treatment=="OTC")
ER_hr <- full_join(ER_CTL, ER_OTC, by="ID")

ER_hr<-dplyr::rename(ER_hr,any_of(c("mean_CTL_hr"="mean.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_hr<-dplyr::rename(ER_hr,any_of(c("mean_OTC_hr"="mean.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_hr<-dplyr::rename(ER_hr,any_of(c("sd_CTL_hr"="sd.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_hr<-dplyr::rename(ER_hr,any_of(c("sd_OTC_hr"="sd.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_hr<-dplyr::rename(ER_hr,any_of(c("n_CTL_hr"="n.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_hr<-dplyr::rename(ER_hr,any_of(c("n_OTC_hr"="n.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
```

```{r calculate effect sizes - heterotrophic respiration, echo=FALSE}

# calculate Hedges SMD
SMD_hr <- escalc("SMD",       m1i = mean_OTC_hr,
                           n1i = n_OTC_hr,
                          sd1i = sd_OTC_hr,
                           m2i = mean_CTL_hr,
                           n2i = n_CTL_hr,
                          sd2i = sd_CTL_hr,
                          data = ER_hr
)

Mean_SMD<-mean(SMD_hr$yi, na.rm = TRUE)

SMD_hr<-dplyr::rename(SMD_hr,any_of(c("SMD_HR"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
SMD_hr<-dplyr::rename(SMD_hr,any_of(c("var_SMD_HR"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

# calculate log response ratio 
# For measure="ROM", the log is taken of the ratio of means (i.e., log(m1i/m2i))
ROM_hr <-
  escalc("ROM", m1i = mean_OTC_hr,
         n1i = n_OTC_hr,
         sd1i = sd_OTC_hr,
         m2i = mean_CTL_hr,
         n2i = n_CTL_hr,
         sd2i = sd_CTL_hr,
         data = ER_hr 
  )

Mean_RR<-mean(ROM_hr$yi, na.rm = TRUE)

ROM_hr<-dplyr::rename(ROM_hr,any_of(c("ROM_HR"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ROM_hr<-dplyr::rename(ROM_hr,any_of(c("var_ROM_HR"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
```

```{r merge data - heterotrophic respiration}
#build data frame for meta analysis
effect <- full_join(SMD_hr, ROM_hr, by = "ID")
meta_effect <- left_join(effect, ER_data, by="ID")
ER_meta <- meta_effect %>% distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

#clean

ER_meta$treatment.x.x <- NULL
ER_meta$treatment.y.x <- NULL
names(ER_meta)[2] <- "mean_CTL_hr"
names(ER_meta)[3] <- "sd_CTL_hr"
names(ER_meta)[4] <- "n_CTL_hr"
names(ER_meta)[5] <- "mean_OTC_hr"
names(ER_meta)[6] <- "sd_OTC_hr"
names(ER_meta)[7] <- "n_OTC_hr"
ER_meta <- ER_meta[,-10:-17] 

```

```{r calculate Heterotrophic/Ecosystems respiration ratio}

# calculate

ER_data$ratio_HR_ER <-(ER_data$co2_heterotrophic_respiration/ER_data$co2_ecosystem_respiration)*100
dat_he <- ER_data[complete.cases(ER_data$ratio_HR_ER), ]
dat_he_sum<-dat_he %>% dplyr::summarise(N = sum(!is.na(ratio_HR_ER)), ratio_HR_ER = mean(ratio_HR_ER, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(ratio_HR_ER, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% dplyr::mutate(se = sd / sqrt(N), ci = se * qt(0.975, N - 1))  # CHANGES: Rmisc::summarySE replaced (Rmisc needs plyr); same N/mean/sd/se/ci columns ##groupvars = c("Growth.form_2"),

#extract values from data file
ER_he <- ER_data %>% 
  group_by(ID, treatment) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(mean=mean(ratio_HR_ER, na.rm = TRUE), 
            sd=sd(ratio_HR_ER, na.rm = TRUE), 
            n=n()
            )
ER_CTL <- ER_he  %>% dplyr::filter(treatment=="CTL")
ER_OTC <- ER_he  %>% dplyr::filter(treatment=="OTC")
ER_he <- full_join(ER_CTL, ER_OTC, by="ID")

ER_he<-dplyr::rename(ER_he,any_of(c("mean_CTL_he"="mean.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_he<-dplyr::rename(ER_he,any_of(c("mean_OTC_he"="mean.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_he<-dplyr::rename(ER_he,any_of(c("sd_CTL_he"="sd.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_he<-dplyr::rename(ER_he,any_of(c("sd_OTC_he"="sd.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_he<-dplyr::rename(ER_he,any_of(c("n_CTL_he"="n.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ER_he<-dplyr::rename(ER_he,any_of(c("n_OTC_he"="n.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

# calculate Hedges SMD
SMD_he <- escalc("SMD",       m1i = mean_OTC_he,
                           n1i = n_OTC_he,
                          sd1i = sd_OTC_he,
                           m2i = mean_CTL_he,
                           n2i = n_CTL_he,
                          sd2i = sd_CTL_he,
                          data = ER_he
)

Mean_SMD<-mean(SMD_he$yi, na.rm = TRUE)

SMD_he<-dplyr::rename(SMD_he,any_of(c("SMD_HE"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
SMD_he<-dplyr::rename(SMD_he,any_of(c("var_SMD_HE"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

# calculate log response ratio 

ROM_he <-
  escalc("ROM", m1i = mean_OTC_he,
         n1i = n_OTC_he,
         sd1i = sd_OTC_he,
         m2i = mean_CTL_he,
         n2i = n_CTL_he,
         sd2i = sd_CTL_he,
         data = ER_he 
  )

Mean_RR<-mean(ROM_he$yi, na.rm = TRUE)

ROM_he<-dplyr::rename(ROM_he,any_of(c("ROM_HE"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ROM_he<-dplyr::rename(ROM_he,any_of(c("var_ROM_HE"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

# RR = exp(ROM)
# percchange = 100*(RR-1)

# Example: ROM=logRR=0.21835 --> RR=1.244 --> %change=24.4
#ROM_he$RR_he =exp(ROM_he$ROM_HE)

effect3 <- full_join(SMD_he, ROM_he, by = "ID")
meta_effect3 <- left_join(effect3, ER_data, by="ID")
ER_meta3 <- meta_effect3 %>% distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

#clean

ER_meta3$treatment.x.x <- NULL
ER_meta3$treatment.y.x <- NULL
names(ER_meta3)[2] <- "mean_CTL_he"
names(ER_meta3)[3] <- "sd_CTL_he"
names(ER_meta3)[4] <- "n_CTL_he"
names(ER_meta3)[5] <- "mean_OTC_he"
names(ER_meta3)[6] <- "sd_OTC_he"
names(ER_meta3)[7] <- "n_OTC_he"
ER_meta3 <- ER_meta3[,-10:-17] 


```
```{r same for autotrophic respiration}
#calculate

dat_au_sum<-dat_au %>% dplyr::summarise(N = sum(!is.na(ratio_AU_ER)), ratio_AU_ER = mean(ratio_AU_ER, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(ratio_AU_ER, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% dplyr::mutate(se = sd / sqrt(N), ci = se * qt(0.975, N - 1))  # CHANGES: Rmisc::summarySE replaced (Rmisc needs plyr); same N/mean/sd/se/ci columns ##groupvars = c("Growth.form_2"),

  group_by(ID, treatment) %>%
```

```{r merge all datasets for analysis}

df<-cbind(ER_meta, ER_meta1[2:11])
df2<-cbind(df, ER_meta2[2:11])
df_meta<-cbind(df2, ER_meta3[2:11])

write.csv(df_meta,"df_4.csv")
```
